scope: Black & White onward through Scarlet & Violet; Unlimited deferred

d.name: Pineco

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

d.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Superpowered Throw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

d.name: Shroomish

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

d.name: Breloom
d.flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

d.name: Cacnea

abilities.name: Counterattack Quills
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

d.name: Cacturne

abilities.name: Counterattack Quills
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

d.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Fresh-Picked Fruit
attacks.text: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

d.name: Scatterbug

abilities.name: Adaptive Evolution
abilities.text: This Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

d.name: Spewpa

abilities.name: Adaptive Evolution
abilities.text: This Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

d.flavorText: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

d.name: Vivillon

attacks.name: Miracle Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Condition. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

d.name: Skiddo
d.flavorText: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

d.name: Gogoat

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

d.name: Sprigatito
d.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

d.name: Floragato
d.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

d.name: Meowscarada

attacks.name: Trick Cape
attacks.text: You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

d.name: Tarountula

attacks.name: String Haul
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

d.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

d.name: Tarountula

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

d.name: Tarountula

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

d.name: Spidops ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Trap Territory
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Wire Hang
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

d.name: Smoliv
d.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

d.name: Smoliv

attacks.name: Nutrients
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

d.name: Dolliv

attacks.name: Apply Oil
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

d.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

d.name: Arboliva

abilities.name: Enriching Oil
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

d.name: Toedscool

attacks.name: Furious Kicks
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

d.name: Toedscool

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

d.name: Toedscruel

attacks.name: Eerie Tentacles
attacks.text: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

d.name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Slightly Spicy
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

d.name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Increasing Spice
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

d.name: Scovillain

attacks.name: Hot Bite
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Super Spicy Breath
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

d.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Relentless Flames
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

d.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

d.name: Arcanine ex
rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Raging Claws
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bright Flame
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

d.name: Houndour
d.flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

d.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

d.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Concentrated Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

d.name: Fuecoco
d.flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

d.name: Crocalor
d.flavorText: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

d.name: Skeledirge

attacks.name: Passionate Singing
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Blazing Shout
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

d.name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

d.name: Charcadet
d.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

d.name: Armarouge

abilities.name: Fire Off
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a Fire Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flame Cannon
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

d.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

d.flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

d.name: Slowbro

abilities.name: Strange Behavior
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

d.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Jump
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

d.name: Gyarados ex
rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tyrannical Tail
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 180 more damage.

d.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

d.name: Buizel
d.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

d.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

d.name: Alomomola

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

d.name: Clauncher
d.flavorText: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

d.name: Clawitzer

attacks.name: Aqua Cannon
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer launches from its claw are powerful enough to punch through tanker hulls.

d.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Vivid Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

d.name: Quaxly
d.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

d.name: Quaxwell
d.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

d.name: Quaquaval

abilities.name: Energy Carnival
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

d.name: Wiglett

attacks.name: Twisting Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

d.name: Wiglett

attacks.name: Dig a Little
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

d.name: Wugtrio

attacks.name: Undersea Tunnel
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

d.name: Cetoddle
d.flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

d.name: Cetoddle
d.flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

d.name: Cetitan

attacks.name: Sweeping Tackle
attacks.text: This attack does 20 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

d.name: Dondozo

attacks.name: Release Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Tatsugiri in your discard pile.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

d.name: Tatsugiri

attacks.name: Mise en Place
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Basic Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Curl Up
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

d.flavorText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

d.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Magnetic Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges electromagnetic waves and so on from the units at its sides.

d.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

d.name: Magnezone ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pulse Launcher
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

d.name: Mareep
d.flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

d.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

d.name: Pachirisu

abilities.name: Electricity Pouches
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Everyone Discharge
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Lightning Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

d.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

d.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

d.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Junk Hunt
attacks.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

d.name: Toxel
d.flavorText: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

d.name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Yank Away
attacks.text: Choose 2 random cards from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

d.name: Pawmi

attacks.name: Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

d.name: Pawmi
d.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

d.name: Pawmo

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

d.name: Pawmot

abilities.name: Electrogenesis
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Electro Paws
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

d.name: Wattrel

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

d.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

d.name: Wattrel
d.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

d.name: Kilowattrel

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

d.name: Miraidon

attacks.name: Lightning Laser
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

d.name: Miraidon ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Tandem Unit
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Photon Blaster
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

d.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Forced Sleep
attacks.text: Your opponent chooses 1 of their Benched Pokémon and switches it with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

d.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Pendulum Influence
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in play and use it as this attack.

d.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

d.name: Ralts
d.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

d.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

d.name: Gardevoir ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Psychic Embrace
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Miracle Force
attacks.text: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

d.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

d.name: Shuppet

attacks.name: Enveloping Shadow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

d.flavorText: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

d.name: Banette ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Everlasting Darkness
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 60 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

d.flavorText: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

d.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Balloon Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

d.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Curse Spreading
attacks.text: Put 8 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

d.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

d.name: Flabébé
d.flavorText: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

d.name: Floette

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage, and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

d.name: Florges

abilities.name: Blooming Garden
abilities.text: Your Pokémon in play have no Weakness.

attacks.name: Moonblast
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

d.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Energy Munch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

d.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Second Bite
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

d.name: Klefki

abilities.name: Mischievous Lock
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities, except for Mischievous Lock.

attacks.name: Joust
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

d.name: Fidough
d.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

d.name: Fidough

attacks.name: Springy
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

d.name: Dachsbun

abilities.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Burned. Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

d.name: Flittle
d.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

d.name: Flittle
d.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

d.name: Flittle

attacks.name: Dash Off
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

d.name: Espathra

attacks.name: Eye Strength
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

d.name: Greavard

d.flavorText: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

d.name: Ralts
d.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

d.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

d.name: Fidough

attacks.name: Springy
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

d.name: Greavard

attacks.name: Graveyard Gamboling
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Psychic Pokémon in your discard pile.

d.flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

d.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

d.name: Sandile
d.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

d.name: Klawf

attacks.name: Adrenaline Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

d.name: Mabosstiff

abilities.name: Intimidating Howl
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

d.name: Bombirdier

attacks.name: Knickknack Carrying
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon Tool cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

d.flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

d.name: Kingambit

abilities.name: Leadership
abilities.text: Your Basic Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

d.name: Starly
d.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

d.name: Skwovet

abilities.name: Nest Stash
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may shuffle your hand and put it on the bottom of your deck. If you put any cards on the bottom of your deck in this way, draw a card.

d.flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

d.name: Sprigatito

attacks.name: Mini Drain
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

d.name: Fuecoco

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

d.name: Quaxly

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

d.name: Mimikyu ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Void Return
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

d.name: Quaquaval

abilities.name: Energy Carnival
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

d.name: Pawmot

abilities.name: Electrogenesis
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Electro Paws
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

d.name: Hawlucha

abilities.name: Flying Entry
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.

d.flavorText: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

d.name: Revavroom

abilities.name: Rumbling Engine
abilities.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

d.name: Spidops

attacks.name: String Truss
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

d.name: Espathra

attacks.name: Aurora Gain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

d.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

d.name: Dondozo

attacks.name: Dangerous Wave
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 100 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

d.name: Miraidon

attacks.name: Lightning Laser
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

d.name: Koraidon

attacks.name: Rampaging Fang
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

d.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Extreme Current
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

d.name: Ampharos ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Thunderstrike Tail
attacks.text: You may discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon to have this attack do 100 more damage.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.name: Baxcalibur

abilities.name: Super Cold
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

d.name: Tinkaton

abilities.name: Gather Materials
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Special Hammer
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

d.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

d.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

d.name: Pelipper

abilities.name: Hearsay
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 1: put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand; or search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and then shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

d.name: Smoliv

attacks.name: Nutrients
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

d.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

d.name: Tinkatink

attacks.name: Smithereen Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

d.name: Varoom

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Adventuring Together
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Pikachu seems excited to be going on an adventure, and so do its new pals, from attention-seeking Sprigatito to laid-back Fuecoco and tidy Quaxly.

d.name: Skeledirge ex

attacks.name: Burning Voice

d.name: Quaquaval ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Exciting Dance
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Spiral Shot
attacks.text: Put 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

d.name: Palafin

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Justice Kick
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

d.name: Cleffa

attacks.name: Grasping Draw
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

d.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

d.name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Precious Gift
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), you may use this Ability. Draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

d.name: Mawile

abilities.name: Special Eater
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

d.name: Pawmi

attacks.name: Static Slap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

d.name: Paldean Wooper

attacks.name: Splattering Poison
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

d.name: Houndstone

attacks.name: Delve
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Item cards from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

d.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

d.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

d.name: Paradise Resort
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Psyduck in play (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless less.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Bulbasaur
d.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

d.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

d.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

d.flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

d.name: Deino

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: It can't see, so its first approach to examining things is to bite them. You will be covered in wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

d.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: The two heads do not get along at all. If you don't give each head the same amount of attention, they'll begin fighting out of jealousy.

d.name: Hydreigon

abilities.name: Tri Howl
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Discard the other cards.

d.flavorText: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

d.name: Maschiff

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

d.name: Maschiff
d.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

d.name: Mabosstiff

attacks.name: Comeuppance
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

d.name: Shroodle

attacks.name: Berry Search
attacks.text: Put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

d.name: Shroodle

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

d.name: Grafaiai

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Colorful Graffiti
attacks.text: You may discard as many Basic Energy cards as you like from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each type of Basic Energy you discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

d.name: Bombirdier

attacks.name: Delivery Pocket
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Dark Edge
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

d.name: Corviknight

attacks.name: Accelerate
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spinning Bird
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

d.name: Cufant
d.flavorText: Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor.

d.name: Copperajah ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bronze Body
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Nosequake
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: Orthworm

abilities.name: Nutritional Iron
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has 3 or more Metal Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

d.name: Noibat
d.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

d.name: Noivern ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Covert Flight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dominating Echo
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Special Energy or Stadium cards from their hand.

d.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

d.name: Farigiraf

attacks.name: Either Face
attacks.text: Choose a player. That player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

d.flavorText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

d.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

d.name: Dudunsparce

attacks.name: Dig Away Flash
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

d.name: Wingull
d.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

d.name: Pelipper

abilities.name: Hearsay
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 1: put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand; or search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and then shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

d.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

d.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Sharp Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

d.name: Slaking

abilities.name: Stir and Snooze
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Asleep, flip 2 coins instead of 1 during Pokémon Checkup. If either of them is tails, this Pokémon is still Asleep.

attacks.name: Slacker's Headstrike
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

d.name: Fletchling

attacks.name: Nosedive
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

d.name: Rookidee

attacks.name: Send Back
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

d.name: Corvisquire

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

d.flavorText: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

d.name: Tandemaus

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

d.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

d.name: Tandemaus
d.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

d.name: Maushold

attacks.name: Gnaw Relentlessly
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon for each of your Maushold in play.

d.flavorText: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

d.name: Squawkabilly ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Squawk and Seize
abilities.text: Once during your first turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Squawk and Seize Ability during your turn.

attacks.name: Motivate
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.name: Flamigo

abilities.name: Insta-Flock
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Flamigo, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

d.name: Artazon

You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Boss's Orders (Ghetsis)
rules: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Bravery Charm
rules: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to gets +50 HP.
Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

d.name: Calamitous Snowy Mountain
rules: Whenever any player attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Basic non-Water Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Calamitous Wasteland
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Basic non-Fighting Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless more.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Choice Belt
rules: The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon V (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

d.name: Clavell
rules: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon with 120 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Delivery Drone
rules: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Dendra
rules: Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. (If you have no other cards in your hand, you can't use this card.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Falkner
rules: Draw 2 cards. If you have a Stadium in play, draw 2 more cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Fighting Au Lait
rules: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Giacomo
rules: Discard a Special Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Great Ball
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Grusha
rules: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If none of your Pokémon have any Energy attached, draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Iono
rules: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Practice Studio
rules: The attacks of Stage 1 Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) do 10 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Saguaro
rules: Choose up to 2 of your Pokémon and heal 50 damage from each of them.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Super Rod
rules: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Superior Energy Retrieval
rules: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.Put up to 4 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't choose a card you discarded with the effect of this card.)
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Jet Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

d.name: Luminous Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.If the Pokémon this card is attached to has any other Special Energy attached, this card provides Colorless Energy instead.

d.name: Reversal Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, and if this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes), this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 3 Energy at a time.

d.name: Therapeutic Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.The Pokémon this card is attached to recovers from being Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed and can't be affected by those Special Conditions.

d.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Smashing Horn
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

d.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tropic Breeze
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

d.name: Sprigatito

attacks.name: Gather Sunlight
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

d.name: Floragato

attacks.name: Magic Whip
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

d.name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

d.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Heat Dive
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

d.name: Pyroar

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

d.name: Fuecoco

attacks.name: Spacing Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

d.name: Crocalor
d.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

d.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Expert Splasher
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

d.name: Marill

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

d.name: Eiscue

attacks.name: Frigid Block
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

d.name: Quaxly

attacks.name: Apply Gel
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

d.name: Quaxwell
d.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

d.name: Frigibax
d.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

d.name: Arctibax
d.flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

d.name: Baxcalibur

abilities.name: Super Cold
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

d.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Electrocharge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

d.name: Mismagius

abilities.name: Magical Flick
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

d.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

d.name: Sandygast
d.flavorText: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

d.name: Rabsca

attacks.name: Revival Blessing
attacks.text: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

d.name: Tinkatink

attacks.name: Scrap Pickup
attacks.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

d.name: Tinkatuff

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Pulverizing Press
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

d.name: Paldean Tauros

attacks.name: Raging Horns
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Combat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

d.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Hit and Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

d.name: Nacli

attacks.name: Salt Coating
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

d.name: Paldean Wooper

attacks.name: Find a Home
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

d.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Rout
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dread Mountain
attacks.text: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

d.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bouquet Magic
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Grass Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Vitality Song

attacks.name: Burning Voice
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.name: Chi-Yu ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jealously Singe
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Flame Surge
attacks.text: Choose up to 3 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.name: Quaquaval ex

attacks.name: Exciting Dance

attacks.name: Hail Blade

attacks.name: Jumping Press

attacks.name: Paralyzing Ball
attacks.text: You may discard 2 Lightning Energy from this Pokémon to make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Profound Knowledge
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Wise Headbutt
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.name: Dedenne ex
rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tail Swap

attacks.name: Wondrous Shot

attacks.name: Scary Fangs

d.name: Annihilape ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Angry Grudge

d.name: Paldean Clodsire ex

abilities.name: Toxic Wetland

attacks.name: Needle Bone
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.name: Copperajah ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bronze Body
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Nosequake
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: Noivern ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Covert Flight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dominating Echo
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Special Energy or Stadium cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Motivate

rules: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Clavell
rules: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon with 120 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Dendra
rules: Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. (If you have no other cards in your hand, you can't use this card.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Falkner
rules: Draw 2 cards. If you have a Stadium in play, draw 2 more cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Giacomo
rules: Discard a Special Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Grusha
rules: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If none of your Pokémon have any Energy attached, draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Iono
rules: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Saguaro
rules: Choose up to 2 of your Pokémon and heal 50 damage from each of them.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Meowscarada ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bouquet Magic
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Grass Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Scratching Nails
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 120 more damage.

d.name: Wo-Chien ex

attacks.name: Covetous Ivy

attacks.name: Burning Voice

attacks.name: Jealously Singe

attacks.name: Flame Surge
