rules: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Superior Energy Retrieval
rules: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.Put up to 4 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't choose a card you discarded with the effect of this card.)
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Sprigatito
d.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

d.name: Fuecoco
d.flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

d.name: Quaxly
d.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

d.name: Cetoddle
d.flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

d.name: Cetitan

attacks.name: Sweeping Tackle
attacks.text: This attack does 20 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

d.name: Pawmi
d.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

d.name: Kilowattrel

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

d.name: Flittle
d.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

d.name: Sandaconda

attacks.name: Sandstorm Spray
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you discarded any Energy in this way, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck.

d.flavorText: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

d.name: Klawf

attacks.name: Adrenaline Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

d.name: Blissey

abilities.name: Busybody Nurse
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Happy Cyclone
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

d.name: Tandemaus

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

d.name: Cyclizar

attacks.name: Touring
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

d.flavorText: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

d.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

d.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.text: Draw a card.

d.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

d.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Inviting Scent
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

d.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

d.name: Bellossom

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Powerful Dance
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

d.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

d.name: Shuckle

attacks.name: Berry Scent
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

d.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

d.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Panic-Prompting Pattern
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

d.flavorText: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

d.name: Combee

attacks.name: Share
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

d.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Enticing Pattern
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Grass Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

d.name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Dangerous Spores
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

d.name: Phantump
d.flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

d.name: Trevenant

abilities.name: Forest Miasma
abilities.text: During Pokémon Checkup, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

d.flavorText: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

d.name: Rowlet
d.flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

d.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

d.name: Decidueye ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Total Freedom
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. If this Pokémon is on the Bench, switch it with your Active Pokémon. Or, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hunting Arrow
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: Bounsweet

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

d.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

d.name: Tsareena

attacks.name: Queenly Heel
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Pokémon can't be played from your opponent's hand to evolve the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spinning Kick
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

d.name: Smoliv

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

d.name: Dolliv

attacks.name: Sunny Wind
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

d.name: Arboliva

attacks.name: Healing Fruit
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

d.name: Toedscruel ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Protective Mycelium
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Colony Rush
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached.

d.name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

d.name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

d.name: Scovillain

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Grass and Fire type.

attacks.name: Spicy Headbutt
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.flavorText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

d.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

d.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

d.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

d.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Nine-Tailed Dance
attacks.text: Put 9 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

d.name: Entei

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

d.name: Numel

attacks.name: Hot Magma
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

d.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Discard the top card of each player's deck. This attack does 100 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

d.name: Victini ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Victory Flame
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

d.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Damage Counterpunch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

d.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

d.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Alluring Fireball
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

d.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Combustion Chain
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

d.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Energy Burner
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

d.name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

d.name: Volcarona

attacks.name: Flame Cloak
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

d.name: Eiscue ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Scalding Block
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

d.name: Charcadet
d.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

d.name: Armarouge

abilities.name: Scorching Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

d.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

d.name: Carvanha
d.flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

d.name: Sharpedo

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

d.name: Buizel

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

d.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Swirling Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards into your opponent's hand.

d.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

d.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Screw Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

d.name: Palpitoad
d.flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

d.name: Seismitoad

abilities.name: Quaking Zone
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost Colorless more.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 100 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

d.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

d.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Frost Purge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

d.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: First Freeze
attacks.text: If you go second and it's your first turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

d.name: Froakie

attacks.name: Try Bouncing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

d.name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

d.name: Wiglett
d.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

d.name: Wugtrio

attacks.name: Entwining Entrapment
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

d.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

d.name: Finizen

attacks.name: Valiant Evolution
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

d.name: Finizen
d.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

d.name: Palafin

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Justice Kick
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

d.name: Magnemite
d.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

d.name: Magneton
d.flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

d.name: Magnezone

attacks.name: Magnetic Repulsion
attacks.text: You may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

d.name: Tyranitar ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Mountain Hurl
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Lightning Rampage
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 100 more damage.

d.name: Tynamo
d.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

d.name: Eelektrik

attacks.name: Volt Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

d.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Suction Shock
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 60 damage to the new Active Pokémon, and then flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

d.name: Thundurus

abilities.name: Adverse Weather
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gigantic Bolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

d.name: Toxel

attacks.name: Slight Intrusion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

d.name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Loud Mix
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

d.flavorText: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

d.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

attacks.name: Techno Turbo
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

d.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Slap Slap

d.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

d.name: Clefable ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Wondrous Moon

d.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Whiny Voice

d.flavorText: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

d.name: Togetic

attacks.name: Shared Peace

d.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

d.name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Precious Gift
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), you may use this Ability. Draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

d.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Psychic Assault
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

d.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

d.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

d.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Mischievous Crunch
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

d.name: Spoink
d.flavorText: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

d.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Powerful Steps
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

d.name: Lunatone

abilities.name: New Moon
abilities.text: If you have Solrock in play, prevent all effects of any Stadium done to your Pokémon in play.

d.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

d.name: Solrock

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

d.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

d.name: Claydol

attacks.name: Kaboom Doll
attacks.text: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10. If you placed any damage counters in this way, this attack also does 120 damage to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

d.name: Vespiquen ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Healing Pheromone
attacks.text: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Phantom Queen

d.name: Sinistea

attacks.name: Cold Tea
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

d.name: Polteageist

attacks.name: Antique Collecting
attacks.text: Put up to 2 in any combination of Item cards and Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Pour Tea
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

d.name: Greavard
d.flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

d.name: Greavard

d.flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

d.name: Houndstone

d.flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

d.name: Houndstone ex

d.name: Diglett

attacks.name: Hole-Diggin' Noggin
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

d.flavorText: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

d.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

d.name: Larvitar
d.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

d.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Blasting Tackle
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

d.name: Nosepass

attacks.name: Iron Collecting
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Basic Metal Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

d.name: Barboach

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

d.name: Whiscash

attacks.name: Raging and Rocking
attacks.text: For each Fighting Energy attached to this Pokémon, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

d.name: Bonsly

attacks.name: Blubbering
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

d.name: Drilbur

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

d.name: Stunfisk

d.flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

d.name: Diggersby

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer

d.flavorText: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

d.name: Crabrawler
d.flavorText: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

d.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact

d.flavorText: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.

d.name: Rockruff
d.flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

d.name: Lycanroc

attacks.name: Finishing Fang
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

d.name: Toedscool
d.flavorText: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

d.name: Toedscruel

attacks.name: Double Whip

d.flavorText: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

attacks.name: Pitch-Black Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

attacks.name: Hug
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

d.flavorText: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

d.name: Malamar

abilities.name: Psychic Insight
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top card of your opponent's deck. If you do, look at the top card of your deck.

attacks.name: Hypnotic Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

d.name: Salandit
d.flavorText: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

d.name: Salazzle
d.flavorText: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

d.name: Scizor

attacks.name: Punishing Scissors
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play that has an Ability.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

d.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Slashing Steel
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Slashing Steel.

d.flavorText: People fashion swords from Skarmory's shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

d.name: Mawile

abilities.name: Special Eater
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

d.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Mirror Draw
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent.

d.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

d.name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Oracle Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

d.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Triple Nose
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Iron Buster
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

d.name: Excadrill
d.flavorText: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

d.name: Pawniard

attacks.name: Triple Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

d.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 120 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

d.name: Kingambit

attacks.name: Strike Down
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has 4 or more damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out.

d.flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

d.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

d.flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

d.name: Meltan
d.flavorText: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

d.name: Melmetal ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Metal-bolize
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Metal Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Full Metal Knuckle
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.name: Varoom

attacks.name: Spinning Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

d.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

d.name: Varoom

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.name: Dratini
d.flavorText: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

d.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Dragon Tail
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

d.name: Dragonite ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Mighty Meteor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 140 more damage. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.name: Altaria

attacks.name: Soothing Lullaby
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. During Pokémon Checkup, your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.

d.flavorText: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

d.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

d.name: Pidgey
d.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

d.name: Pidgeotto
d.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

d.name: Pidgeot ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Quick Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Quick Search Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Blustery Wind
attacks.text: You may discard a Stadium in play.

d.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Spike Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

d.flavorText: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

d.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Cheer Up
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

d.name: Zigzagoon
d.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

d.name: Linoone

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

d.name: Swablu

attacks.name: Fluffy Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

d.name: Lillipup
d.flavorText: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won't forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

d.name: Herdier
d.flavorText: The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

d.name: Stoutland

attacks.name: Chomp Chomp Panic
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It's said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

d.name: Audino

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.

d.name: Bouffalant

abilities.name: Bouffer
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Damage Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

d.name: Bunnelby

attacks.name: Stompy Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

d.name: Yungoos

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

d.flavorText: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

d.name: Gumshoos

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

d.name: Skwovet

attacks.name: Nicked Nibble
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

attacks.name: Slip 'n' Roll
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Slip 'n' Roll.

d.name: Lechonk
d.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

d.flavorText: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

d.name: Oinkologne

attacks.name: Finest Selection
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Perfume Press
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

d.name: Flamigo

attacks.name: Synchronized Feathers
attacks.text: If Flamigo is on your Bench, this attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

d.name: Arven
rules: Search your deck for an Item card and a Pokémon Tool card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Brassius
rules: Count the cards in your hand, shuffle those cards into your deck, then draw that many cards plus 1.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Geeta
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. During this turn, your Pokémon can't attack. (This includes Pokémon that come into play this turn.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Letter of Encouragement
rules: You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.
Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Ortega
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck. If you put a card on the bottom of your opponent's deck in this way, your opponent may draw a card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Patrol Cap
rules: As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, cards in your deck can't be discarded by effects of your opponent's attacks, Abilities, Item cards, Pokémon Tool cards, or Supporter cards.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Pokémon League Headquarters
rules: Attacks used by each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) cost Colorless more.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Poppy
rules: Move up to 2 Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Ryme
rules: Draw 3 cards. Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Team Star Grunt
rules: Put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon on top of their deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Town Store
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Vengeful Punch
rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Inviting Scent
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

d.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

d.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Nine-Tailed Dance
attacks.text: Put 9 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

d.name: Palafin

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Justice Kick
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

d.name: Bellibolt

abilities.name: Insulator
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Lightning Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderous Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

d.name: Cleffa

attacks.name: Grasping Draw
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

d.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

d.name: Larvitar
d.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

d.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

d.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Tranquil Flower
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dangerous Toxwhip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

d.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Blazing Destruction
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

d.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

d.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
