d.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Free Diving
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Basic Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

d.name: Blastoise ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Solid Shell
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Twin Cannons
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 140 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

d.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Leaf Munch
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Grass Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

d.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Defensive Posture
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

d.flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

d.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bye-Bye Flight
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Shuffle that Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck, and then shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck. If your opponent has no Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

d.name: Weedle
d.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

d.name: Kakuna

abilities.name: Cocoon Cover
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

d.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

d.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Nadir Needle
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 120 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

d.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

d.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

d.name: Pidgeotto
d.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

d.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

d.name: Rattata

attacks.name: Gnaw the Wound
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

d.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Second Bite
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

d.name: Spearow

abilities.name: Evolutionary Advantage
abilities.text: If you go second, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn.

d.flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

d.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Beak Catch
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

d.name: Ekans

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

d.name: Arbok ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Menacing Fangs
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

d.name: Raichu

abilities.name: Electrical Grounding
abilities.text: When 1 of your Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move a Lightning Energy from that Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

d.name: Sandshrew

abilities.name: Sand Screen
abilities.text: Trainer cards in your opponent's discard pile can't be put into their deck by an effect of your opponent's Item or Supporter cards.

d.flavorText: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

d.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Spike Rend
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage.

d.flavorText: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

d.name: Nidoran ♀

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

d.name: Nidorina

attacks.name: Fetch Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

d.name: Nidoqueen

attacks.name: Queen Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

d.name: Nidoran ♂
d.flavorText: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

d.name: Nidorino
d.flavorText: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

d.name: Nidoking

abilities.name: Enthusiastic King
abilities.text: If you have Nidoqueen in play, ignore all Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Venomous Impact
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

d.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Moon-Viewing Invitation
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Clefairy and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

d.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Follow Me
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

attacks.name: More Moon
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.

d.flavorText: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

d.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

d.name: Ninetales ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Mirrored Flames
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 140 more damage.

d.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Stompy Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

d.name: Wigglytuff ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Expanding Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

attacks.name: Friend Tackle
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.name: Zubat

abilities.name: Revealing Echo
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may have your opponent reveal their hand.

d.flavorText: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

d.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

d.name: Oddish
d.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

d.name: Gloom

abilities.name: Semi-Blooming Energy
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

d.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

d.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Fully Blooming Energy
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 8 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

d.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

d.name: Paras

attacks.name: Spore Ball
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

d.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Spread Filaments
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Search your deck for a number of Grass Pokémon up to the number of heads and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

d.name: Venonat
d.flavorText: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

d.name: Venomoth

attacks.name: Perplexing Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

d.flavorText: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

d.name: Diglett
d.flavorText: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

d.name: Dugtrio
d.flavorText: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

d.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Come Here Right Meow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

d.flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

d.name: Persian

abilities.name: Rocket Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Giovanni's Charisma card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

d.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Overthink
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever they flip a coin, treat it as tails.

d.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

d.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Aquatic Rescue
attacks.text: Put up to 4 Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

d.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

d.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Rant and Rave
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Raging Smash
attacks.text: If this Pokémon isn't Confused, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

d.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Vaporize
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

d.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Torrid Torrent
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Fire Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamite Fang
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

d.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

d.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

d.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Bubble Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Heroic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 150 more damage.

d.flavorText: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

d.name: Abra
d.flavorText: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

d.name: Kadabra

attacks.name: Teleportation Attack
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

d.name: Alakazam ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dimensional Hand
attacks.text: This attack can be used even if this Pokémon is on the Bench.

d.name: Machop

attacks.name: Mountain Mashing
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

d.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Mountain Ramming
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

d.name: Machamp

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Mountain Chopping
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

d.name: Bellsprout

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

d.flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

d.name: Weepinbell
d.flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

d.name: Victreebel

attacks.name: Slow-Acting Acid
attacks.text: At the end of your opponent's next turn, put 12 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

d.name: Tentacool
d.flavorText: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

d.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Poisonous Whip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Tentacular Panic
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If the first flip is tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

d.name: Geodude

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

d.name: Graveler

attacks.name: Rock Cannon
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

d.name: Golem ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dynamic Roll
attacks.text: During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Rock Blaster
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

d.name: Ponyta

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

d.flavorText: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

d.name: Rapidash

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Mach Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

d.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Sea Bathing
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon, and it recovers from all Special Conditions.

d.flavorText: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

d.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Big Yawn
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep.

attacks.name: Laid-Back Tackle
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved during this turn, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

d.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Big Explosion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

d.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Junk Magnet
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Item cards from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

d.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Package Deal
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

d.flavorText: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

d.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

d.name: Dodrio

abilities.name: Zooming Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 1 damage counter on this Pokémon. If you do, draw a card.

attacks.name: Ballistic Beak
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

d.name: Seel
d.flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

d.name: Dewgong

attacks.name: Dual Splash
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

d.name: Grimer

attacks.name: Gummy Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

d.flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

d.name: Muk

attacks.name: Sticky Jail
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost Colorless more, and its Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

d.flavorText: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

d.name: Shellder

attacks.name: Shell Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

d.name: Cloyster

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 80 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

d.name: Gastly
d.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

d.name: Haunter

abilities.name: Spirit Return
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your opponent's discard pile into their hand.

d.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

d.name: Gengar

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

attacks.name: Hollow Dive
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

d.flavorText: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

d.name: Onix

attacks.name: Thumpalanche
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. This attack does 80 damage for each Pokémon with a Retreat Cost of exactly 4 that you discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

d.name: Drowzee
d.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

d.name: Hypno

abilities.name: Here for Hypnosis
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Asleep.

d.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

d.name: Krabby

attacks.name: Salt Water
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

d.name: Kingler

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

d.name: Voltorb

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

d.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Bang Boom Chain
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tools from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

d.flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

d.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

d.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

d.name: Cubone

abilities.name: Cheering Bone
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, attacks used by your Marowak do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Hit Twice
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

d.name: Marowak

attacks.name: Bone Throw
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

d.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Twister Kick
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

d.name: Hitmonchan

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Excited Punch
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Excited Punch attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

d.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Tongue-Tied
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

d.name: Koffing

attacks.name: Suspicious Gas
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

d.name: Weezing

abilities.name: Let's Have a Blast
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Spinning Fumes
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

d.name: Rhyhorn

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

d.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Charismatic Drill
attacks.text: If you played Giovanni's Charisma from your hand during this turn, this attack does 140 more damage.

d.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

d.name: Chansey

abilities.name: Lucky Bonus
abilities.text: If you took this Pokémon as a face-down Prize card during your turn and your Bench isn't full, before you put it into your hand, you may put it onto your Bench. If you put this Pokémon onto your Bench in this way, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card.

d.flavorText: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

d.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Tactful Tangling
attacks.text: If you played Erika's Invitation from your hand during this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

d.name: Kangaskhan ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Triple Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Incessant Punching
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

d.name: Horsea
d.flavorText: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

d.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Blinding Ink
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips 2 coins. If either of them is tails, that attack doesn't happen.

d.flavorText: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

d.name: Goldeen

attacks.name: Triple Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

d.name: Seaking

attacks.name: Swim Freely
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Horn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

d.name: Staryu

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

d.name: Starmie

abilities.name: Mysterious Comet
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this Pokémon and all attached cards.

d.flavorText: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

d.name: Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Mimic Barrier
abilities.text: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psypower
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

d.flavorText: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

d.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Helpful Slash
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Grass Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

d.name: Jynx ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Heart-Stopping Kiss
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, it is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

d.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Electro Combo
attacks.text: If Magmar is on your Bench, this attack does 40 more damage.

d.flavorText: With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.

d.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Flare Combo
attacks.text: If Electabuzz is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage.

d.flavorText: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

d.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Reckless Throw
attacks.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

d.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Gather the Crew
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

d.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Splashy Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, draw a card.

d.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

d.name: Gyarados

abilities.name: Untamed One
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you must discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

d.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Hop on My Back
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

d.name: Ditto

abilities.name: Transformative Start
abilities.text: Once during your first turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck and choose a Basic Pokémon you find there, except any Ditto. If you do, discard this Pokémon and all attached cards, and put the chosen Pokémon in its place. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

d.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Colorful Friends
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

d.name: Vaporeon

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fighting Whirlpool
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

d.name: Jolteon

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fighting Lightning
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

d.name: Flareon

attacks.name: Destructive Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fighting Blaze
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

d.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Conversion 4
attacks.text: Choose Grass, Fire, Water, Lightning, Psychic, Fighting, Darkness, Metal, or Dragon type. Until the Defending Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, its Weakness is now that type. (The amount of Weakness doesn't change.)

d.flavorText: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

d.name: Omanyte

attacks.name: Tentacular Return
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

d.name: Omastar

abilities.name: Primordial Tentacles
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Aqua Split
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

d.name: Kabuto

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

d.name: Kabutops

abilities.name: Ancient Way
abilities.text: Apply Weakness for your opponent's Active Pokémon as ×4 instead.

attacks.name: Draining Blade
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

d.name: Aerodactyl

attacks.name: Devolution Ray
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

d.flavorText: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

d.name: Snorlax

abilities.name: Voraciousness
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put up to 2 Leftovers cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Thudding Press
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

d.name: Articuno

abilities.name: Ice Float
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

d.name: Zapdos ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Voltaic Float
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Lightning Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Multishot Lightning
attacks.text: This attack also does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: Moltres

abilities.name: Flare Float
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Blazing Flight
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

d.name: Dratini
d.flavorText: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

d.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

d.name: Dragonite

abilities.name: Jet Cruise
abilities.text: Your Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

d.flavorText: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

d.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Reflective Barrier
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psyslash
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

d.name: Mew ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Restart
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Genome Hacking
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

d.name: Antique Dome Fossil
rules: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.  At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

abilities.name: Domed Armor
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.name: Antique Helix Fossil
rules: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.  At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

abilities.name: Helical Swell
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Stadium cards from their hand.

d.name: Antique Old Amber
rules: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.  At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

abilities.name: Amber Protection
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

d.name: Big Air Balloon
rules: The Stage 2 Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Bill's Transfer
rules: Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Pokémon you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Cycling Road
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard a Basic Energy card from their hand in order to draw a card.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

d.name: Daisy's Help
rules: Draw 2 cards. Look at your face-down Prize cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Energy Sticker
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Erika's Invitation
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench. If you put a Pokémon onto their Bench in this way, switch in that Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Giovanni's Charisma
rules: Put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand. If you do, attach an Energy card from your hand to your Active Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Grabber
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Pokémon you find there on the bottom of their deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Leftovers
rules: At the end of your turn, if the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, heal 20 damage from it.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Protective Goggles
rules: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to has no Weakness.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Rigid Band
rules: The Stage 1 Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

d.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

d.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Blazing Destruction
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

d.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

d.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

d.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

d.flavorText: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

d.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Free Diving
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Basic Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

d.flavorText: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

d.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Leaf Munch
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Grass Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

d.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

d.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

d.name: Nidoking

abilities.name: Enthusiastic King
abilities.text: If you have Nidoqueen in play, ignore all Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Venomous Impact
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

d.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Overthink
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever they flip a coin, treat it as tails.

d.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

d.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

d.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Mountain Ramming
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

d.flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

d.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Tactful Tangling
attacks.text: If you played Erika's Invitation from your hand during this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

attacks.name: Bind Down

attacks.name: Menacing Fangs

abilities.name: Expanding Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

attacks.name: Friend Tackle
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Mind Jack

attacks.name: Dimensional Hand
attacks.text: This attack can be used even if this Pokémon is on the Bench.

d.flavorText: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

d.name: Tinkaton

attacks.name: Crushing Blow

attacks.name: Alloyed Hammer

d.flavorText: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

d.name: Gimmighoul

d.flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

d.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

d.name: Gligar

attacks.name: Toxic

d.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

d.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Toxic Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

d.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

d.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Swelling Power

attacks.name: Magma Purge

d.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

d.name: Gible
d.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

d.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Power Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

d.name: Mienfoo
d.flavorText: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

d.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Three-Step Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Whip Expert
attacks.text: If you attached a Pokémon Tool card from your hand to this Pokémon during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

d.flavorText: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

d.name: Hoopa ex
rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bandit's Fist
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Bandit's Fist.

d.name: Minior

abilities.name: Far-Flying Meteor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, when you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gravitational Tackle
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

d.flavorText: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

d.name: Toxtricity ex
rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Gaia Punk
attacks.text: Discard 3 Lightning Energy from your Pokémon.

d.name: Nacli

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

d.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

d.name: Nacli

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

d.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

d.name: Naclstack

attacks.name: Rocky Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

d.name: Garganacl

abilities.name: Energizing Rock Salt
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, heal 30 damage from that Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

d.name: Klawf

attacks.name: Unhinged Scissors
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 160 more damage.

attacks.name: Boiled Press
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

d.name: Flamigo

attacks.name: Combat Beak
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

d.name: Slither Wing

attacks.name: Stomp Off
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Burning Turbulence
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

d.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

d.name: Sandy Shocks ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Magnetic Absorption
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if your opponent has 4 or fewer Prize cards remaining, you may attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthen Spike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.name: Ting-Lu

attacks.name: Sand Bringer
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Arrogant Impact
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has 4 or more damage counters on it, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

d.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

d.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

d.name: Crobat

attacks.name: Echoing Madness
attacks.text: Choose Item cards or Supporter cards. During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any of the chosen cards from their hand.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.

d.name: Absol

attacks.name: Drawareness
attacks.text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand until you have 4 or fewer. Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Enhanced Blade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

d.flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

d.name: Purrloin
d.flavorText: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

d.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Dishonest Swap
attacks.text: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

d.name: Trubbish

attacks.name: Venomous Hit
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

d.name: Garbodor

attacks.name: Chuck
attacks.text: Discard any number of Pokémon Tool cards from your hand. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Venomous Hit
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

d.flavorText: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

d.name: Yveltal

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dark Edge
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

d.name: Nickit

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

d.name: Thievul

abilities.name: Rob-'n'-Run

d.flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

d.name: Morpeko

abilities.name: In a Hungry Hurry
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Energizer Wheel
attacks.text: Move 2 Darkness Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

d.name: Lokix

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Punishing Kick
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

d.name: Brute Bonnet

abilities.name: Toxic Powder
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has an Ancient Booster Energy Capsule attached, you may make both Active Pokémon Poisoned.

attacks.name: Rampaging Hammer
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

d.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

d.name: Jirachi

abilities.name: Stellar Veil
abilities.text: Prevent all damage counters from being placed on your Benched Pokémon by effects of attacks used by your opponent's Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Charge Energy
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

d.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

d.name: Ferroseed
d.flavorText: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's spikes grow big and strong.

d.name: Ferrothorn

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Spinning Needles
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Spinning Needles attack does 100 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

d.name: Durant

attacks.name: Swarming Rage

attacks.name: Hard Scissors
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

d.flavorText: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

d.name: Honedge

d.flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

attacks.name: Swords Dance

d.flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

d.name: Aegislash

abilities.name: Mysterious Shield
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V.

attacks.name: Hard Bashing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

d.name: Aegislash ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Peerless Edge

attacks.name: Double-Edged Slash
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

d.name: Zacian

attacks.name: Iron Roar
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Metal Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Brave Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

attacks.name: Luster Burn
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crunch-Time Rush
attacks.text: If there are 3 or fewer cards in your deck, this attack does 150 more damage.

d.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

d.name: Gholdengo ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

d.name: Altaria ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

d.name: Tatsugiri

attacks.name: Survival Strategy
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

d.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Data Displacement
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

d.flavorText: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

d.name: Porygon2

attacks.name: Powered Ball
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

d.name: Porygon-Z

abilities.name: Buggy Turbo
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, attach up to 4 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. If tails, discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energized Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

d.flavorText: Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can't agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.

d.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Filch
attacks.text: Draw a card.

d.flavorText: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

d.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Hand Fling
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your hand.

d.flavorText: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

d.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Lively Tackle
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

d.name: Whismur

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

d.flavorText: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it's exhausted, then it falls asleep.

d.name: Loudred

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

d.flavorText: The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

d.name: Exploud

attacks.name: Sudden Shout
attacks.text: Discard your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards. If this Pokémon didn't evolve from Loudred during this turn, this attack does nothing.

d.flavorText: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it'll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

d.name: Spinda

abilities.name: Tangled Feet
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Confused and is damaged by an attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Teetering Steps
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

d.flavorText: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

d.name: Swablu

attacks.name: Bind Wound
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

d.flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

d.name: Tandemaus

attacks.name: Damage Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

d.flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

d.name: Tandemaus

attacks.name: Tumble Over
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

d.flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

d.name: Maushold ex

abilities.name: Solidarity
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon for each of your Tandemaus, Maushold, and Maushold ex in play.

attacks.name: Nom-Nom-Nom Incisors
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

d.name: Bombirdier ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Fast Carrier
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Shadowy Wind
attacks.text: You may put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

d.name: Cyclizar

attacks.name: Driving Buddy
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

d.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

d.name: Iron Jugulis

attacks.name: Homing Headbutt
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 3 of your opponent's Pokémon that have any damage counters on them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Baryon Beam
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Future Booster Energy Capsule attached, this attack can be used for ColorlessColorlessColorless.

d.flavorText: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Counter Catcher
rules: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.  Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Defiance Vest
rules: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, the Pokémon this card is attached to takes 40 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Earthen Vessel
rules: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

d.name: Future Booster Energy Capsule
rules: The Future Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost, and the attacks it uses do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Larry

You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

d.name: Mela

You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Norman
rules: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, draw 2 more cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Parasol Lady

You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Professor Sada's Vitality
rules: Choose up to 2 of your Ancient Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you attached any Energy in this way, draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Professor Turo's Scenario
rules: Put 1 of your Pokémon in play into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Rika
rules: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Roark
rules: Draw 2 cards. Put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Shauntal
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If tails, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

d.name: Snorlax Doll
rules: If this card is in your hand when you are setting up to play, you may put it face down in the Active Spot or on your Bench as if it were a 120-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. (You can do this only when you are setting up to play.) At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.     This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. If this card is Knocked Out, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

rules: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.text: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

d.name: Technical Machine: Devolution

You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

attacks.name: Devolution
attacks.text: Devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

d.name: Technical Machine: Evolution
